text:
alice: Quick heads-up — my SDK PR is ready but it's blocked on api change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/289

alice: The api PR updates the auth header shape (adds x-rdwd-feature) and a small response field rename. I tried to keep backward compat but the console needs a tiny tweak. @ben can you review the API?

ben: On it. quick glance: looks fine but needs a migration note for the header change. also add a feature-flag gate in the client (`enable_new_auth`) so console can toggle.

alice: Good call. I'll add `enable_new_auth` to the SDK config and a toggle in the console.

sam: I can pick up the console tweak tomorrow morning. blocking question: does the api change require a runtime kernel change? runtime team to confirm. @marta fyi for helm bump sequencing.

marta: Helm/ops note — if api requires minor runtime image bump we need to coordinate chart versions. prefer doing chart bump after api and console are merged to avoid cross-repo rollback pain. suggest canary in staging for 30m then promote.

alice: Proposed rollout plan: 1) api PR merges (with migration note) 2) sdk PR merged and new package released (npm/pypi) 3) console PR toggles on flag and deploys to staging 4) helm bump + runtime image -> canary then prod. Thoughts?

ben: LGTM. add an expiration on the feature flag (30d) in the SDK so we remember to remove shim later. :thumbsup:

merge-bot: merge check failed for sdk PR — conflicts detected with `package-lock.json` and `helm/values.yaml`.

ci-bot: tests for api PR passed:
```
Ran 142 tests, 142 passed, 0 failed
Integration: 12/12 passed
Latency regression: no significant change
```

alice: Re: merge conflicts — the `helm/values.yaml` conflict is from the runtime chart version bump in another branch. I'll rebase SDK and push a fix.

sam: If you rebase, ping me with a quick diff. I'll do a fast console review after CI.

marta: I'll tag infra to reserve a short window for the canary (1 hour) tomorrow at 10:00 PT once we have final artifacts.

alice: Done — rebased and pushed. @ben @sam can you re-review when you have a minute? PR links above.

ben: Reviewing now, should be quick.

sam: Reviewing console change, small nit in UI logging — will leave a comment.

ben: Approving API PR, left migration note. :white_check_mark:

sam: Console review done, approved after nit fix.

merge-bot: All approvals present. Scheduling merge window at 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z.

marta: Confirmed canary slot reserved 2026-03-18T17:15Z — ops will watch.

alice: Thanks everyone — going to cut the SDK release once merge completes. I'll post a short release note and the removal TODO for the feature flag.

ben: Nice work. :rocket:
